mentions.name: Jose Alvarado
mentions.analysis: With Deonte Murray, CJ McCollum, Trey Murphy, and Herb Jones out, Alvarado is a must-roster player due to the lack of guards available. He will get a lot of opportunities and is expected to play significant minutes.

mentions.name: Jordan Hawkins
mentions.analysis: Similar to Alvarado, Hawkins is a must-roster player with multiple guards out for New Orleans. He is expected to play significant minutes and has a high opportunity for scoring and three-pointers.

mentions.name: Moritz Wagner
mentions.analysis: With Paolo Banchero out and Wendell Carter Jr. questionable, Wagner becomes a must-add player. He could start and play significant minutes, increasing his scoring and rebounding opportunities.

mentions.name: Eve Missi
mentions.analysis: Missi is a great streaming option due to increased playing time with current injuries. He has potential for blocks and rebounds.

mentions.name: Tim Hardaway Jr.
mentions.analysis: Hardaway is a boom-bust option for points and three-pointers. With limited teams playing, he has an opportunity to play significant minutes.

mentions.name: Jonathan Isaac
mentions.analysis: Isaac has potential for steals and blocks, but his playing time is uncertain due to his recovery from injury. He could be valuable if he plays more minutes.

mentions.name: Anthony Black
mentions.analysis: With Paolo Banchero out, Black is expected to start and could provide assists. His shooting may be inconsistent, but he has potential for six or seven assists.

mentions.name: Ziaire Williams
mentions.analysis: Williams could see increased playing time if Ben Simmons is out. He has potential for scoring and three-pointers.

mentions.name: Malik Beasley
mentions.analysis: Beasley is a good option for three-pointers. He has the potential to hit multiple threes in a game.

mentions.name: Garrison Mathews
mentions.analysis: Mathews could be a good option for three-pointers if Dyson Daniels plays less. His upside is limited but he can contribute in this category.
